c009.title: At the burger place
c009.story: After the cinema, Max wants [[fast food]]. Anna laughs: "That is [[junk food]], Max!" Cars wait in line at the [[drive-through]]. But Anna, Max, and his cousin Ihor go inside. Every [[burger]] on the menu looks good. A [[hamburger]] has meat in a bun. A [[cheeseburger]] has meat and cheese. Max takes the cheese one with [[ketchup]] and [[mayonnaise]]. He also gets a chocolate [[milkshake]]. Anna takes a small [[sundae]]. Ihor wants fruit, so he orders a [[smoothie]]. Max has sauce on his nose, and they laugh.

c010.title: Sunday breakfast at home
c010.story: On Sunday morning, Anna's mama made a big breakfast. She put bread in the [[toaster]]. Soon there was hot [[toast]] with [[jam]] on the table. Then she dipped more bread in eggs and milk for [[French toast]]. Next came [[pancakes|pancake]] with sweet [[syrup]]. Dad cooked [[bacon]] and a cheese [[omelet]]. Anna ate everything and felt very happy. Only her brother Taras was on a diet. He ate just [[yogurt]] and half a [[grapefruit]]. But ten minutes later, his plate was full!

c011.title: At the supermarket
c011.story: Anna and Max go to the [[supermarket]]. Friends come for dinner tonight. Max puts [[broccoli]] and an [[avocado]] in the cart. Anna loves [[citrus]] fruit. She takes a yellow [[lemon]] and a green [[lime]]. Then she adds a [[tangerine]] and a [[mandarin]]. "What is the difference?" Max asks. Anna smiles, "Both are small, orange, and sweet!" They also take a big [[mango]] and four [[kiwis|kiwi]]. For snacks, they get [[cheddar]] and [[crackers|cracker]]. At the checkout, Max looks at the long bill. It is a big dinner!

c013.title: Baking a birthday cake
c013.story: Anna and her mom bake for Grandma's birthday. First, they put all the [[ingredients|ingredient]] on the table. They have no sugar, so honey is their [[substitute]]. Mom adds [[cinnamon]] and a spoon of vanilla [[extract]]. Anna takes the [[blender]], but Mom says it is for drinks. So Anna turns on the [[mixer]], and Mom sets the [[timer]]. Soon twelve [[cupcakes|cupcake]] and six [[muffins|muffin]] come out of the oven. Anna puts pink [[icing]] only on the cupcakes. Then they make a [[cheesecake]] and a tray of [[brownies|brownie]]. Mom bakes an apple [[tart]], and Anna makes chocolate [[fudge]] with [[pecans|pecan]]. Last, they make Grandma's favorite [[red velvet]] cake. In the evening, Grandma tries everything and smiles.

c014.title: A barbecue at the dacha
c014.story: On Saturday Anna's family has a [[barbecue]] at the dacha. Dad connects the [[propane]] tank carefully. He checks the [[regulator]] twice. "You can't be too careful with [[gas]]," he says. Then he cooks [[hot dogs|hot dog]] for everyone. Later he puts a big piece of [[roast beef]] on the [[grill]]. After a day in the garden, everyone has a huge [[appetite]]. The kids drink cold [[lemonade]] in the shade. In the evening they roast [[marshmallows|marshmallow]] over the fire. Nobody wants to go back to the city.
